memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: "Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever." — Hebrews 13:8

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
​Humanity often finds itself caught in a pursuit of "true happiness" that the world promises but never truly delivers. This pursuit mimics the original mistake made by Adam: choosing the temporal, forbidden fruit over the eternal presence of God. Today, we face a world in constant flux, where deceptive techniques create a sense of panic and confusion, making it increasingly difficult to discern good from evil. We often find ourselves reaping the consequences of long-held worldly attachments, feeling the weight of a choice made long before we realized its cost.
​The fundamental struggle lies in our inability to see that the world’s offerings are merely shadows. While the world demands our constant adaptation to its shifting values, Jesus offers divine stability. His love is not a reaction to our performance; it is an eternal, proactive force. His forgiveness is permanent, providing a sanctuary from the reaping of our past mistakes. In a world that is passing away, Christ remains the only destination where our souls can find rest without the fear of change or decay.  
​God's love is following us and He wants to bless us with the fruit of eternal life. Just sow the seeds of good fruit and you will reap in abundance. God is waiting patiently to make your life eternal in the future. Shift your focus from the shifting world and set it on the unchanging Jesus.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: "Change is the only constant in the world, but  Christ is the only constant in eternity."

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
​Heavenly Father, I confess that my eyes often wander toward the flickering lights of this changing world. Forgive me for the times I have sought happiness in things that fade away. Grant me the wisdom to discern truth from deception and the strength to choose the eternal over the temporal. I anchor my soul today in the unchanging nature of Jesus Christ. May His permanent love be my peace in the midst of the world’s panic.
Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: Today, you may feel pushed by the rapid changes around you, but remember that you do not have to be swept away. The world’s happiness is a shadow; Christ’s joy is a bedrock. Choose the Unchanging One today, and you will find a peace that the world can neither give nor take away.
